name: Turso
description: In-process SQL database compatible with SQLite, written in Rust.
summary: Turso welcomes contributions made with AI coding agents, provided the human contributor understands, reviews, and can defend the work. AI-generated summaries should be rewritten or heavily edited for accuracy; the document does not set AI-specific rules for issues.

evidence.quote: We expect you to understand the code you submit. The best AI-assisted contributions come from people who treat the agent as a collaborator, not a substitute: you direct the work, review it critically, and own the result.
Always self-review your code before submitting - make sure it's correct and follows the existing code standards in this repo.
Describe the change in your own words, or heavily edit any AI-generated summary so it reads naturally and accurately.
